name: lookup_license
description: What a software, model or data license allows and requires: OSI and FSF status, patent grant, copyleft scope, obligations, facts, CounselMode's editorial view and provenance.

arguments.name: license
arguments.desc: An SPDX ID ("Apache-2.0"), a name, or an alias ("ALv2", "GPLv3").

name: model_license
description: The license an AI model is released under, keyed by exact model and version (licenses differ between versions of the same family).

arguments.name: model
arguments.desc: The exact model and version, e.g. "Gemma 4", "Llama 3.1", "DeepSeek-R1".

name: project_license
description: The license a well-known software project is released under, keyed by version: projects change licenses (Redis, Elasticsearch, Terraform), so the answer depends on the release.

arguments.name: version
arguments.desc: The version in use, e.g. "7.4" or "1.5.7". Omit to get every license era.

name: check_compatibility
description: Whether code under `inbound` can go into a work under `outbound`, for a distributed combined work and for SaaS.

arguments.name: inbound
arguments.desc: The license of the code or component you want to use.

arguments.name: outbound
arguments.desc: The license of your project, or 'proprietary'.

name: license_obligations
description: What a license requires for one use (internal, SaaS, distribution or a device), with CounselMode's rating: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, BLOCK or REVIEW (depends on facts the data cannot know), and `because`, the reason.

arguments.name: license
arguments.desc: An SPDX ID, name or alias.

name: triage_dependencies
description: A first pass over a dependency list: each component's license resolved and rated for the scenario (SPDX expressions: OR takes the least risky choice, AND the most).

arguments.name: components
arguments.desc: One license or SPDX expression per line, or CSV/TSV text with a license column (and optionally name or component). At most 500 rows.

name: choose_license
description: Which license to release your own software, model weights or dataset under, for a stated goal.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.desc: What the user wants from their license. Ask them; do not infer it.

arguments.name: must_be_open_source
arguments.desc: False only if the user accepts source-available or use-restricted licenses.

arguments.name: includes
arguments.desc: Licenses of code the project includes or combines with (SPDX IDs or names).

name: search
description: Search license and AI model records.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Words to search license and model records for.

name: fetch
description: The full text of one license or model record, with its source URL and verification status.
